stories.title: Houthi missile debris damages kindergarten and medical center in Riyadh

en.title: Houthi missile debris damages kindergarten and medical center in Riyadh
en.summary: Debris from an intercepted Houthi ballistic missile caused material damage to a kindergarten and medical clinic complex in Riyadh on Thursday. Emergency teams responded to the incident after fragments struck the facilities.

en.title: Moroccan conjoined twins separated successfully
en.summary: A Saudi medical team successfully separated 13-month-old Moroccan conjoined twins Saja and Duha at King Abdullah Specialist Children's Hospital in Riyadh as part of the Saudi Conjoined Twins Program.

stories.title: King Salman invites UAE president to attend 2nd GCC-EU Summit

en.title: King Salman invites UAE president to attend 2nd GCC-EU Summit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman invited the UAE president to attend the second GCC-EU Summit scheduled to take place in Saudi Arabia this month. Officials discussed Gulf and European cooperation prospects.

stories.title: Separation surgery of Moroccan conjoined twins begins in Riyadh

en.title: Separation surgery of Moroccan conjoined twins begins in Riyadh
en.summary: A specialized Saudi medical team began a complex separation surgery for 13-month-old Moroccan conjoined twins Saja and Doha at a children's hospital in Riyadh.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s King Salman invites UAE president to second EU-GCC summit

en.title: Saudi Arabia's King Salman invites UAE president to second EU-GCC summit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman has formally invited the UAE president to attend the second EU-Gulf Cooperation Council summit that the Kingdom will host this month. The invitation was delivered through Saudi Arabia's ambassador to the UAE during discussions about enhancing cooperation between the GCC and EU.

stories.title: King Salman and Crown Prince congratulate Justina Shiroka-Pula on taking oath as Kosovo's president

en.title: King Salman and Crown Prince congratulate Justina Shiroka-Pula on taking oath as Kosovo's president
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman congratulated Justina Shiroka-Pula on her election as Kosovo's president. The two Saudi leaders expressed wishes for her success and for Kosovo's continued progress and prosperity.

stories.title: Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait intercepted

en.title: Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait intercepted
en.summary: Saudi coalition forces intercepted Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh and Khamis Mushait. The interceptions followed recent Houthi attacks on civilian facilities that killed three people and injured over 30, drawing condemnations for threatening regional security.

en.summary: A Saudi medical team successfully separated conjoined twins from Morocco.

stories.title: ‎eXtra sees continued sales growth in Q4

en.title: eXtra sees continued sales growth in Q4
en.summary: United Electronics Co. expects sales growth to continue in Q4 2026, supported by seasonal shopping demand, product variety, and multiple distribution channels. The company is preparing with adequate inventory levels to meet anticipated customer demand.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia, UAE sign MoU on electricity, rail connectivity

en.title: Saudi Arabia, UAE sign MoU on electricity, rail connectivity
en.summary: Saudi Arabia and the UAE signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen cooperation in electricity connectivity, exchange, trading, and rail infrastructure. The agreement aims to maximize economic benefits for both nations through interconnected systems.

stories.title: ‎Alwasail signs SAR 11.97M contract with Al-Sabaq Al-Arabi

en.title: Alwasail signs SAR 11.97M contract with Al-Sabaq Al-Arabi
en.summary: Alwasail Industrial Co. signed an 11.97 million riyal contract for manufacturing and supplying materials for National Water Co's sewage network projects over 12 months. Financial impact is expected from Q4 2026 through 2027.

stories.title: ‎Economic Council reviews key economic topics, reports

en.title: Economic Council reviews key economic topics, reports
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Economic and Development Affairs Council met to review global economic developments, focusing on inflation, central bank policies, and their effects on the Saudi economy. The council emphasized the kingdom's economic resilience amid geopolitical changes.
